description: Cognitive tag definitions for the Story Explorer reading comprehension assessment.

question_type_mapping.literal: Questions about explicit story details (who, what, where, when)
question_type_mapping.inferential: Questions requiring reasoning beyond stated text (why, how, theme)
question_type_mapping.vocabulary: Questions about word meaning in context

tags.description: Child recalls and identifies stated facts from the text accurately.
Child draws valid conclusions and inferences beyond the literal text.
Child understands literal content but struggles to infer meaning.
Child determines word meanings from surrounding context effectively.
Child has difficulty determining word meaning from context.
Child demonstrates strong understanding of audio-narrated stories.
